title: docs: the moe-proxy README's env list documents a MOE_DAEMON_PORT override the proxy never reads, calls MOE_PROJECT_PATH required although it defaults to the cwd, and omits five MOE_* variables the proxy does read
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #4 (task-130a6a5c). Evidence is from HEAD 430e4620, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout.

PROBLEM
packages/moe-proxy/README.md:47-56 ("## Environment Variables") is the proxy's env reference, and the npm page shows it. It disagrees with the code three ways.
1. README.md:51 says "`MOE_DAEMON_PORT` - Daemon port (default: read from .moe/daemon.json)". No code reads that variable.
   - `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT 430e4620 -- packages docs scripts moe-jetbrains moe-vscode` prints only README.md:51. It came in with the first README (1a5a36bb, Feb 2026) and was never implemented.
   - The port comes only from daemon.json: src/index.ts:501 `const daemonInfo = readDaemonInfoResult(projectPath);`, then `info.port` at :529 and :541, then :554 `new WebSocket(\`ws://${getDaemonHost()}:${port}/mcp\`)`. With no daemon.json, the proxy retries for about 5 minutes and exits 1 (:504-519).
   - A user who follows the README is silently ignored. With no daemon.json the proxy exits; with one, it dials the daemon.json port instead.
2. README.md:49 says "`MOE_PROJECT_PATH` - Project path (required)". But src/utils.ts:162 has `return path.resolve(process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH || process.cwd());`, so it defaults to the cwd. docs/CONFIGURATION.md:36 already says "Current directory".
3. The list omits five variables the proxy does read:
   - MOE_WORKER_ID (src/index.ts:731, injectWorkerId; semantics at src/utils.ts:200-215);
   - MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT and MOE_RUNNER_HOST (src/index.ts:732, injectRunnerIdentity; semantics at src/utils.ts:250-260);
   - MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS (src/index.ts:40, `parsePositiveIntEnv(process.env.MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS, 30000)`);
   - MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE (src/index.ts:83; semantics at src/utils.ts:455-470: `underscore` exposes `moe_<name>` for grok, anything else is `dot`).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: `cd /tmp/hunt-130a-B/packages/moe-proxy && npx vitest run src/hunt-daemon-port.test.ts src/hunt-daemon-port-control.test.ts`. The test spawns the proxy through tsx against a .moe/ with no daemon.json, MOE_DAEMON_PORT set to a ws server on port 0, and one tools/call on stdin. Verbatim output:
  ```
  MOE_DAEMON_PORT=46783; daemon connections=0; frames received=0
  × connects to the daemon on MOE_DAEMON_PORT when daemon.json is absent
  ```
  Proxy stderr: `[moe-proxy] Daemon not running, retrying in 1156ms (attempt 1)` ... `(attempt 3)`.
  The control is the same harness with the port in daemon.json instead. It passes: `Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)`.
- Saved in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-130a/B/: hunt-daemon-port.test.ts, hunt-daemon-port-control.test.ts, daemon-port-repro.txt, daemon-port-control.txt.
- Mechanical check, which prints 6 difference lines at HEAD:
  ```
  diff <(grep -rhoE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' packages/moe-proxy/src --include=*.ts --exclude=*.test.ts | sort -u) <(sed -n '/^## Environment Variables/,/^## One-shot/p' packages/moe-proxy/README.md | grep -oE 'MOE_[A-Z_]+' | sort -u)
  ```

FIX DIRECTION
This is docs-only. Edit packages/moe-proxy/README.md's Environment Variables list:
- Delete the MOE_DAEMON_PORT line. Don't implement the override in this row. The connection is deliberately keyed on daemon.json plus the /health identity probe (src/index.ts:529-541), so a port override would need its own design.
- Change MOE_PROJECT_PATH to say it defaults to the current directory.
- Add one line each for MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT plus MOE_RUNNER_HOST, MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 30000) and MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE. Describe each from the code lines cited above. Several are launcher-set: say so, as the MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS line already does ("Wrapper-only").

Out of scope: any src change, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and the README's other sections.

FILES: packages/moe-proxy/README.md (only).
definitionOfDone: `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT HEAD -- packages docs scripts moe-jetbrains moe-vscode` prints nothing (the README line is deleted, and no code was added for it)

implementationPlan.description:
Edit packages/moe-proxy/README.md with the Edit tool, and only inside '## Environment Variables' (lines 47-57 at 6029cee3). The full target section is saved as /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-56f77335/env-section.md (sha256 b5b7b72b13711b6f3c050f62daa421251ab60ee7fe982b97b7637176a74725a3) and the diff as readme.diff (sha256 75139e3d1e381f488ccaf57cc6fae955f99e6fef8d325c1a37104cefd0012b3f; git apply --check passes at 6029cee3). Copy from them; never git apply (rail: tracked files only via Edit/Write).
(a) Line 49 becomes: - `MOE_PROJECT_PATH` - Project path, where the proxy reads `.moe/daemon.json` (default: the current directory)
  Source: src/utils.ts:162, `path.resolve(process.env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH || process.cwd())`.
(b) Delete line 51 (MOE_DAEMON_PORT). Do not implement the override. The port comes only from daemon.json `info.port`, gated by the /health identity probe (src/index.ts:501-554).
(c) After the MOE_DAEMON_HOST line add these two lines:
- `MOE_WORKER_ID` - Launcher-set. The seat's worker id, added as `workerId` to every `tools/call` that omits one, and to `tools/list` so the daemon lists only the tools for the seat's role. `moe.get_activity_log` never gets it, because its `workerId` is a filter. A blank value counts as unset
  Source: src/index.ts:731 injectWorkerId, src/utils.ts:180-245 including WORKER_ID_IS_A_FILTER.
- `MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT` and `MOE_RUNNER_HOST` - Launcher-set, for architect, QA and governor seats only. The runner identity, added as `processStartedAt` and `host` to a `moe.claim_next_task` that names neither key, so a task claimed inside the session can be reattached after a daemon restart. Both must be non-blank, or neither is sent
  Source: src/index.ts:732 injectRunnerIdentity, src/utils.ts:250-286.
(d) After the MOE_BLOCKING_TIMEOUT_MS line add these two lines:
- `MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS` - The per-request deadline of every other request; when it passes, the proxy answers that request with a `Request timed out` error (default: 30000)
  Source: src/index.ts:40 and :273-283, and the error text at :343.
- `MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE` - Launcher-set for grok. `underscore` exposes each `moe.<name>` tool as `moe_<name>` in `tools/list` and maps the alias back on `tools/call`, for clients that drop dotted tool names. Any other value, or none, keeps the daemon's names
  Source: src/index.ts:83, src/utils.ts:455-470 (trimmed, case-insensitive 'underscore', else dot).
(e) After the MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS line add one blank line, then: The daemon port always comes from `.moe/daemon.json`; no environment variable overrides it.
Keep the MOE_DAEMON_HOST, MOE_SESSION_ID, MOE_ATTEMPT_*, MOE_WORKER_TYPE, MOE_BLOCKING_TIMEOUT_MS and MOE_PROXY_ONESHOT_DEADLINE_MS lines byte-identical. The section may name no MOE_* variable beyond the 13 the proxy's non-test sources mention. That excludes MOE_DAEMON_PORT even in prose, which both DoD greps would catch. Every other README section, and every other file, stays untouched.

Verification. From the worktree root, run the executionContract checkRef verbatim (also saved as /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-56f77335/checkref.txt, sha256 ac05c0d8ea87b141b58d7292f9694501c000725d0f6b0241fcc1b9481b7097fb, 808 chars). It is the DoD in one command:
- DoD 1: a working-tree `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT` over packages, docs, scripts, moe-jetbrains and moe-vscode prints nothing. It is the uncommitted form of the DoD's `git grep ... HEAD`, which QA runs after landing.
- DoD 2: the DoD's exact names diff prints nothing.
- DoD 3: the MOE_PROJECT_PATH line names the current directory and no longer says 'required'; the MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS line has 30000.
- DoD 4: the README with the section bodies stripped (headers kept) equals the merge-base copy, and `git diff --name-only` against the merge base lists only packages/moe-proxy/README.md.
Planner dry run on a scratch copy of 6029cee3: exit 0, printing the two matched lines and ` packages/moe-proxy/README.md | 9 +++++++--` (7 insertions, 2 deletions). The unchanged README exits 1. So do 10 negative controls: port line kept, a name missing, '(required; ...)', 'Required.', no 30000, no 'current directory', an edit outside the section, a second file changed, MOE_DAEMON_PORT in prose.
Its fresh output is the complete_task verification evidence. No npm command is needed: no test or build reads this README, and the landing qualityGate (parity-check + role-doc lint) does not touch it.
Error handling for a red run: the failing link prints its own evidence (a git grep hit, a diff line, or a missing match). Fix the README text and rerun; never edit the command.

Self-review (load the adversarial-self-review skill), scoped to this one-file docs diff. Re-read each new line against the source it cites in step 1:
- MOE_WORKER_ID: tools/call injection only when args has no workerId key; tools/list gets it too; the get_activity_log filter exception; blank means unset.
- Runner pair: injected only when neither key is present; both values non-blank or neither is sent; set for architect, QA and governor seats only.
- MOE_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS: every request with an id that is not one of the three blocking long-polls; default 30000 (an invalid or non-positive value keeps it).
- MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE: 'underscore' (trimmed, any case) or else dot.
Confirm that no line overclaims: for example, the proxy never reads MOE_WORKER_ID from anywhere but the env. Confirm the Markdown list still renders as one list. Confirm no added text contains a project.json globalRails.forbiddenPatterns string.
For QA: re-run the checkRef at the control checkout with MOE_LAND_TARGET=<completion>^ and QA_TIP=<completion>. Without QA_TIP, the daemon's uncommitted .moe/ diffs there trip the name-only check. Then also run the DoD's literal `git grep -n MOE_DAEMON_PORT HEAD -- packages docs scripts moe-jetbrains moe-vscode`.
